variants.title: Op-amp integrator with a 22 nF feedback capacitor
variants.sample: Unknown capacitor from the E6 series (22 nF)
variants.unknown: the feedback capacitor from the ramp slope
variants.note: A larger capacitor makes the ramp gentler, so the same input gives a smaller output swing.

variants.title: Op-amp integrator with a 47 nF feedback capacitor
variants.sample: Unknown capacitor from the E6 series (47 nF)
variants.unknown: the feedback capacitor from the ramp slope
variants.note: The ramp is about five times gentler than with 10 nF, so the slope reading has fewer volts to work with.
